title: Update runtime release notes template to include quant perf highlights + known caveats
creator: Talia Benson
description:
## Context
We’re landing multiple FP8/INT8 kernel + scheduler changes during the FP8/INT8 kernel benchmarking sprint. Release Engineering needs a consistent way to communicate:
- What changed for quantized inference performance (and where it improved / didn’t).
- Any rollout knobs, GPU/model limitations, and accuracy/correctness caveats.

Today the runtime release notes template has a generic “Performance improvements” section, but it isn’t structured enough to capture quant-mode specifics (FP8 vs INT8), phase-specific metrics (prefill vs decode), and “when to pin / rollback” guidance.

## Goal
Update the runtime release notes template so every runtime train that includes quant-related changes ships with:
1) a standardized **Quantized inference performance** section (highlights + metrics + scope)
2) a standardized **Known caveats / rollout notes** section (limitations + mitigations)
3) a small **Validation / canary checklist** for on-call + release captain

## Proposed template changes (to be applied to the runtime release notes template)
### A) New section: Quantized inference performance (FP8/INT8)
**Purpose:** Make it obvious what improved, on which GPUs/models/workloads, and which metric moved.

**Required fields (fill with data or explicitly state N/A):**
- Quant mode(s): FP8 | INT8 | both
- GPU scope: A100 | H100 | H200 | L40S (explicit)
- Model families affected: Llama-family / Qwen-family / Mistral-family (explicit)
- Runtime flags/knobs (if any): e.g., kernel family override, scheduler batch cap override
- Metrics (use ADR names): TTFT, TPOT, tokens/sec, p95 latency; specify prefill vs decode if relevant
- Workload shape: prefill-heavy vs decode-heavy; streaming vs non-streaming; concurrency range

**Recommended formatting:**
- 2–4 bullet highlights (“what changed”)
- Mini table with before/after deltas (p50 + p95) where available
- Link to benchmark report / dashboards for full matrix

**Template snippet (verbatim):**
- **Quantized inference performance (FP8/INT8):**
  - **Scope:** <quant mode>, <GPU(s)>, <model families>, <workload preset(s)>
  - **Highlights:**
    - <1–3 bullets>
  - **Results (bench suite):**
    - TTFT: <p50/p95 delta> (streaming chat)
    - TPOT: <p50/p95 delta>
    - Throughput: <tokens/sec delta>
  - **Notes:** <e.g., improvements limited to decode / prefill / specific shapes>
  - **Links:** <dashboard>, <runbook>, <sprint report>

### B) New section: Known caveats / rollout notes (quantized paths)
**Purpose:** Put “gotchas” in one predictable place so Support/SRE can quickly recommend mitigations.

**Template snippet (verbatim):**
- **Known caveats / rollout notes (FP8/INT8):**
  - **Compatibility:** <unsupported ops/layers>, <fallback behavior>
  - **Accuracy/correctness guardrails:** <drift threshold policy>, <what triggers fallback>
  - **GPU-specific notes:** <e.g., L40S conditional disables>, <H200 tuning gated by capability detection>
  - **Mitigations:**
    - If latency regresses on INT8: <pin runtime>, <disable/force kernel family>, <adjust scheduler cap>
    - If output quality issues suspected on FP8: <switch to FP16>, <disable FP8>, <run drift check command>
  - **Rollout:** <canary cohort>, <rollback criteria>

### C) Add a “Validation checklist” block for release captain
**Template snippet (verbatim):**
- **Quant validation checklist (release captain):**
  - [ ] Perf-canary quant job green (nightly + release candidate run)
  - [ ] No new correctness failures in quant drift CI
  - [ ] Dashboard shows no p95 regressions > threshold on tracked GPU/model presets
  - [ ] Any allowlisted regressions documented with mitigation + owner

## Acceptance criteria
- Release notes template updated (runtime train template in the release-eng repo / internal template doc).
- Template includes the two new sections above, with explicit prompts for: metric names, workload shape, GPU scope.
- Includes at least one concrete example block (filled-out) using sprint data as a reference.
- Socialize with Runtime (Noah/Rina) + SRE (Sean/Allison) for terminology consistency.

## Rollout plan
- Apply template changes to the next runtime train (runtime-1.21) and require release captain to fill quant sections when quant PRs are included.
- Add lightweight lint/checklist item in the release train issue template (manual is fine for now).

## Notes
- Keep language customer-safe (no internal code names). Include “how to mitigate” first, then root cause details.
- Use metric definitions from the quant benchmark ADR (TTFT/TPOT definitions + aggregation rules).
comments: Connor O'Brien (2025-09-30): Drafted updated template sections (Quant perf + Caveats + Validation). Pulled mitigation bullets directly from recent Support triage patterns (pin runtime / force kernel family / disable FP8). Will ask Runtime to sanity-check metric naming matches ADR.

Noah Patel (2025-10-01): Looks good. Please explicitly separate TTFT/TPOT and call out streaming chat vs non-streaming completion. Also add a note to always state GPU scope (A100 vs H100 behave differently).

Allison Grant (2025-10-02): +1. Add a ‘Links’ line that points to the quant dashboard and to the benchmark runbook. Also recommend a standard tag set (model family, GPU SKU, runtime commit, quant mode) in the release notes so we can correlate quickly.

Sean Gallagher (2025-10-03): For on-call usability, put mitigations at the top of caveats (what to do first). Mention that perf-lab results can differ if GPU clocks aren’t pinned; keep it short but link to the runbook.

Connor O'Brien (2025-10-07): Updated template per feedback: added streaming vs non-streaming fields; added explicit GPU scope line; added ‘Mitigations’ first under caveats; added required Links list (dashboard + runbook + sprint report).
Talia Benson (2025-10-10): Approved. Please apply this to runtime-1.21 release notes and add a checkbox to the release captain checklist (manual is fine).
Connor O'Brien (2025-10-11): Done. Template updated and used for runtime-1.21 draft. Added checklist item in release captain doc. Closing ticket.
